english.title: Refuse / fail to comply with request to provide information to Treasury
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse,

(A)_[refused]_
(B)_[failed within the time and the manner specified]_
(C)_[failed within a reasonable time and in the manner specified]_

to comply with a request by the Treasury for information under regulation 26 of the Global Anti-Corruption Sanctions Regulations 2021
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 28(1)(a) and 31(3)(a) of the Global Anti-Corruption Sanctions Regulations 2021.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without reasonable excuse
refused / failed within the time and in the manner specified OR
where no time specified, within a reasonable time
to comply with a request to provide information
made by the Treasury under regulation 26 of the Global Anti-Corruption Sanctions Regulations 2021

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Where a person is convicted for this offence, the court can make an order requiring the person to comply with the request within a specified period, see regulation 28(2) of the Global Anti-Corruption Sanctions Regulations 2021.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, without reasonable excuse,

(A)_[refused]_
(B)_[failed within the time and the manner specified]_
(C)_[failed within a reasonable time and in the manner specified]_

to comply with a request by the Treasury for information under regulation 26 of the Global Anti-Corruption Sanctions Regulations 2021.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
